name: Nebo
overview: Nebo is a multifaceted biblical term referring to a city allotted to the tribe of Reuben and a city in the territory of Judah, as seen in Numbers 32:3 and Ezra 2:29. Most notably, Mount Nebo is the mountain east of the Jordan where Moses was commanded to view the Promised Land before his death, as described in Deuteronomy 32:49-50 and Deuteronomy 34:1. The Scriptures also indicate Nebo as a subject of prophetic significance and as the name of a Babylonian idol, highlighting its varied roles in biblical history.
